summary: The change implements RegExp.escape in escape.rs only. I walked every step of RegExp.escape and EncodeForRegExpEscape against the pinned spec text and found no defects. The TypeError check, the leading-digit/letter \x escape, and the SyntaxCharacter, ControlEscape, otherPunctuators, WhiteSpace, LineTerminator and surrogate branches all match the spec's conditions and output. The 16 otherPunctuators code points, the 15 SyntaxCharacter code points plus '/', and the WhiteSpace/LineTerminator sets are all correct. Lone surrogates are handled as their own code points, and the \u and \x escapes are lowercase and padded correctly. There are no test-shaped branches, no swallowed errors, and no made-up values. The two remaining failures come from String.prototype.codePointAt being unimplemented in another built-in, which is an honest not-implemented error.
